transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been hearing my name called when nobody’s there. It’s happened at home, like from the hallway, and once at the warehouse too. It sounds real—like my husband is standing right next to me saying it—and it scared me enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
Have you been feeling unusually high, energized, or wired lately?

Yeah… I guess so. At first I felt really fired up, like I could do anything with my craft business, and I was getting pretty intense about how things should be done around the house. But I was also getting irritated fast. My husband would say something small, and I’d snap at him like he was trying to stop me or hold me back.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah. For a while I was only sleeping like two, maybe three hours a night, and then I’d wake up feeling ready to get up and do things. It didn’t feel like I needed more sleep—more like sleeping was just taking time away from my projects.
During this time, have you felt like you had special abilities or were more powerful or important than usual?

Yeah… I did. I really believed I could take my crafts and turn it into a real retirement business right away, like I had figured out the perfect plan for our family. I felt like once everyone saw it, they’d know I was right.
During this time, were you doing a lot more activities or projects than usual?

Yes. I was doing way more than normal. I’d come home from the warehouse and instead of resting, I’d start tearing through closets, rewriting schedules, looking up genealogy stuff, making lists… just one thing after another. It was like I couldn’t sit still.
Did that unusually energized or irritable mood last for at least a week?
Yes. It lasted longer than a week—about three weeks altogether, from when I was all wound up and restless until I kind of crashed.
Did you hear your name being called only during that three-week period when you felt unusually energized and slept very little?

Yes. It was during that same stretch, when I was barely sleeping and talking all the time and felt like I had to fix everything. Before that, and after I got really low and withdrawn, I didn’t hear my name or have anything like that.
Around the time this started, had you used any drugs or stimulants?
I don’t really have anything specific to point to there. I mean, I wasn’t taking anything like that that I can remember. If you mean street drugs or uppers, no, not that I know of.
After that energized period ended, did you go through a stretch of feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes. After all that running around and arguing, I just dropped. I felt heavy and empty most days, like I’d sit at the kitchen table and start crying over nothing. It felt like I couldn’t get myself back.
During that low period, did you hear your name being called?

No, not during the low period. That only happened when I was barely sleeping and really wound up, talking nonstop and feeling like I had to fix everything. Once I crashed and got withdrawn, I wasn’t hearing my name or having anything like that.
